pages.definition: A subtle form of sarcasm where the speaker delivers an ironic statement with a flat, emotionless expression (deadpan). In advanced interactions, this invites a reciprocal response where the listener 'plays along' with the facade rather than acknowledging the irony directly.
visualCues: Unblinking stare or prolonged eye contact
Neutral or completely relaxed mouth corners
Micro-expressions of amusement (tiny smirk) that vanish quickly
Still posture contrasting with the absurdity of the statement
toneCues: Normal or slightly slower speaking tempo
Lack of typical stress markers on key words
Hyper-politeness or formal vocabulary in casual settings

scenario.description: You and a colleague just left a 3-hour meeting that achieved very little. Your colleague turns to you while checking their watch.

audioSample.tonalPrompt: Flat, serious, and weary, but masking it with polite professional admiration.

pages.transcript: I honestly believe that discussion about the stapler inventory was the highlight of my fiscal quarter. Truly riveting stuff.

appropriateResponse.description: Match the colleague's deadpan energy. Do not laugh or point out the sarcasm. Instead, escalate the absurdity of the praise to show you share their frustration.
keyElements: Maintain a serious or thoughtful tone
Validate the absurd premise (that the meeting was good)
Add a detail that highlights the boredom without explicitly stating it

scenario.description: You and a friend are attempting to set up a tent in a sudden, torrential downpour. Everything is soaked.

audioSample.tonalPrompt: Cheery and optimistic, but slightly too loud to compete with the rain noise.

pages.transcript: You know, the brochure really undersold the aquatic features of this campsite. It's like a spa treatment and a bedroom all in one.

appropriateResponse.description: Reciprocate the optimism. Do not complain about the rain. Frame the disaster as a luxury feature.

scenario.description: Your partner accidentally burnt the dinner lasagna to a crisp. It is completely black on top.

audioSample.tonalPrompt: Thoughtful, critical, like an art critic examining a sculpture.

pages.transcript: I think the char really adds a nice structural integrity to it. It's very bold to serve a dish that crunches before you even bite it.

appropriateResponse.description: Accept the 'compliment' as if you intended to burn it. Engage in the culinary critique of the disaster.
keyElements: Use a proud or artistic tone
Claim the mistake was an intentional stylistic choice
Do not apologize immediately; play out the scene first
